response.sql: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(NULLIF(fillcount, 0)) AS avg_fill FROM orderexecutions GROUP BY ordersmark), first_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS value FROM per_order), first_kept AS (SELECT p.avg_fill, p.avg_fill - b.value AS first_excess FROM per_order AS p CROSS JOIN first_benchmark AS b WHERE p.avg_fill > b.value), second_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS value FROM first_kept), final_orders AS (SELECT f.avg_fill, f.first_excess, f.avg_fill - b.value AS second_excess FROM first_kept AS f CROSS JOIN second_benchmark AS b WHERE f.avg_fill > b.value) SELECT AVG(avg_fill) AS avg_per_order_fill, AVG(first_excess) AS avg_first_excess, AVG(second_excess) AS avg_second_excess FROM final_orders
